utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning all, Friday already. Let's get through it. Quick stand-up, what you've done, what's on today, any issues. Marc, you were on nights overlap, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, morning. Bit grim out there. Also, side note, the broken coffee machine in the canteen is still broken, so if anyone's wondering why I look miserable, that's why.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Thought that was just your face, mate.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Cheers, Callum.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, very supportive team as ever. Go on then, Marc.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Plant's been steady enough. No major alarms overnight. I signed off the inspection on the new line on Tuesday, so that's done already, nothing to carry there. This morning I'll take vibration readings on the Boiler Feedwater Pump by 11am.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good, thanks. Get them logged straight after if you can.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, will do.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Callum?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Morning. Production's alright, line one had a scrappy start but it's running. Got a bit of rework to clear, not massive. Um, what else... no fresh stoppages from my side.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: We do need the risk assessment updating for work on the line 1 TCU. Callum, can you pick that up?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Today? I can, but honestly I'm tied up with the cover rota and the line one issue first thing. I won't do a proper job on it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fair. Marc, can you take that instead?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, alright. I'll update the risk assessment for work on the line 1 TCU by end of day.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Nice one.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Morning all. On controls, I tested the Engel yesterday and it's all fine now, so that's closed out. No new faults come back overnight.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Good result.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah. I've got a couple of trend reviews but nothing I need from anyone right now.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Cheers. David?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Morning. Mechanically we're mostly alright. Had a listen round the pumps first thing, nothing screaming at me. Water ring still sounds a bit rough, same as yesterday.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, and on that sort of area, I saw the pressure on the Waste Heat Boiler dip for a few minutes, it came back on its own. Just an observation really, not saying it's a job for today unless it does it again.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, noted as an observation only. Keep an eye on the trend.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Mm. Also stacker's still dead in the water till parts land, isn't it?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yep, still waiting on parts for the stacker, nothing we can do until they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fine, so that's a blocker, not today's action. Jamie, while you're on, I do need you to book a contractor to look at the water ring tomorrow, not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, okay. I'll get someone booked, a contractor to look at the water ring, for tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: I'll see who can actually come out at short notice, but yeah, I'll sort the booking.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good. Priya?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Morning. Electrical side's mostly quiet. I already swapped the filter on the cold unit yesterday, so that's done, no need to mention it again after today.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Ta, that helped actually.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: And before anyone asks, we were going to replace the belt on the GT1 fuel valve but that's been pushed to next month so ignore it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, cancelled for now, understood.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Also, whoever's got the new blue thing in the car park, tidy. Better than Marcus's shed anyway.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Oi, it's not a shed, it's classic.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: It's classic in the sense bits fall off it, yeah.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, Top Gear later. Anything for today, Priya?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah. I'll grease and check the bearings on the front end of one by end of day. Been meaning to get eyes on that properly.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: And I'll check the guarding on the IM2 as well. Fairly important, that, because it didn't look quite right when I walked past.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, thanks Priya. Get maintenance sheet updated when you've done it.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Will do.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Back to you, Callum, one for planning ahead. I need someone to recalibrate the sensors on the boiler safety valve next week, top priority please. Can you take that, Callum?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, I can take it. I'll recalibrate the sensors on the boiler safety valve next week.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good, cheers.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: I can help if you need a second pair of hands on the instrumentation side, Callum.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, might grab you when I set it up.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Anything else that absolutely needs assigning?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: There was the toolbox talk.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah. We do need to organise the toolbox talk for the team after lunch, not an emergency but don't let it slip. Who wants that?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: I can't do after lunch, I'm in the production review.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: I've got IM2 and front end of one, so I'd rather not overcommit.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: I'm in and out on phones with contractors most of the afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: I've got panel checks and then calibration prep, so same here really.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: I'm tied up till 11 with the Boiler Feedwater Pump and then the line 1 TCU paperwork.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, so organise the toolbox talk for the team after lunch, not an emergency but don't let it slip, but nobody's taking it right now. We'll have to see how the day goes.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: I can join it if it happens, just can't organise it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Any permit clashes today?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Not from production, as long as Marc's risk assessment is done before anyone touches that TCU.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, that's the plan. I'll update the risk assessment for work on the line 1 TCU by end of day, and nobody goes near it before the paperwork's right.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: On the Boiler Feedwater Pump, Marc, if the vibration readings are ugly, shout me before lunch.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Will do. I'm taking vibration readings on the Boiler Feedwater Pump by 11am anyway, so you'll know soon enough.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: If you're over that side, have a glance whether the cable tray's still rattling. Not a task, just if you see it.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, alright, if I'm there.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Anything safety-wise besides IM2 guarding?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: No, that was the main one. Like I said, I'll check the guarding on the IM2. Fairly important but I don't think it's an immediate stop.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: For the water ring contractor, do we want our usual lot first?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: I'd say yes, they've seen it before.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, go usual first. Just to repeat, Jamie, book a contractor to look at the water ring tomorrow, not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yep, got it. Jamie will sort that.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Very formal, that.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: I contain multitudes.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Mm-hm. Priya, on front end of one, do you need isolations?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Just local by the look of it. I'll grease and check the bearings on the front end of one by end of day, should be straightforward unless it's hotter than expected.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Give me a nudge if the bearings feel rough, I might come and have a proper look.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah, no worries.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Sarah, anything from compliance?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Only that paperwork wants tightening up before the audit trail review. So Marc's TCU risk assessment matters, and Callum's boiler safety valve sensors next week are top of the list.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Understood on that. The recalibration on the boiler safety valve is top priority please, and I'll get it lined up for next week.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Can we also get the coffee machine listed as critical plant?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Only if your car goes on the asset register.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: No. Absolutely not. Anything else real?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Nothing from me.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: All good here.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: No, that's me.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Same.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: All set.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yep.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, actions are clear. Marc on Boiler Feedwater Pump by 11 and the line 1 TCU risk assessment by end of day, Priya on front end of one by end of day and IM2 guarding, Callum on boiler safety valve next week, Jamie booking the water ring contractor for tomorrow. Toolbox talk still needs an owner after lunch if someone frees up. Cheers, everyone.
